source: Egyptian Real Estate Publicity Law 9/2022, Income Tax Law (Art. 42) and developer schedules

items.name: Developer transfer fee (تنازل)
items.note: Set by each developer's contract; confirm in writing before paying a deposit.

items.name: Brokerage commission
items.note: Customary resale brokerage rate in Egypt when a broker introduces the deal.

items.name: Maintenance deposit
items.note: Usually due before handover; check receipts if the unit is already delivered.

items.name: Real Estate Publicity registration (الشهر العقاري)
items.note: Law 9/2022 caps registration fees at EGP 2,000 plus surveying fees up to EGP 3,900.

items.name: Real estate disposition tax (ضريبة التصرفات العقارية)
items.note: 2.5% of the sale value on non-village real estate transfers; legally due from the seller.
